### `create_time_entry`

**Create a time entry** · `POST /api/v2/team/{team_Id}/time_entries` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Create a time entry.

***Note:** A time entry that has a negative duration means that timer is currently running for that user.*

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_Id` | path | number | yes | Workspace ID |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<details>
<summary><code>body</code> fields (12)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `tags[]` | object[] |  | Unlimited uses of time entry tags are available on the Business Plus and Enterprise Plan. |
| `tags[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `tags[].tag_fg` | string | yes |  |
| `tags[].tag_bg` | string | yes |  |
| `start` | integer | yes |  |
| `stop` | integer |  | The `duration` parameter can be used instead of the `stop` parameter. |
| `end` | integer |  |  |
| `billable` | boolean |  |  |
| `duration` | integer | yes | When there are values for both `start` and `end`, `duration` is ignored. The `stop` parameter can be used instead of the `duration` parameter. |
| `assignee` | integer |  | Workspace owners and admins can include any user id. Workspace members can only include their own user id. Unlimited uses of creating time entries for other people is available on the Business Plus and Enterprise Plan. |
| `tid` | string |  | You can provide a task ID to associate the time entry with a task. Unlimited uses of time entries that are not associated with tasks are available on the Business Plus and Enterprise Plan. |

</details>

### `get_time_entries_within_date_range`

**Get time entries within a date range** · `GET /api/v2/team/{team_Id}/time_entries` · API v2 · 🟢 read-only

View time entries filtered by start and end date.

By default, this endpoint returns time entries from the last 30 days created by the authenticated user.

To retrieve time entries for other users, you must include the `assignee` query parameter.

Only one of the following location filters can be included at a time: `space_id`, `folder_id`, `list_id`, or `task_id`.

***Note:** A time entry that has a negative duration means that timer is currently running for that user.*

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_Id` | path | number | yes | Workspace ID |
| `start_date` | query | number |  | Unix time in milliseconds |
| `end_date` | query | number |  | Unix time in milliseconds |
| `assignee` | query | number |  | Filter by `user_id`. For multiple assignees, separate `user_id` using commas. **Example:** `assignee=1234,9876` ***Note:** Only Workspace Owners/Admins have access to do this.* |
| `include_task_tags` | query | boolean |  | Include task tags in the response for time entries associated with tasks. |
| `include_location_names` | query | boolean |  | Include the names of the List, Folder, and Space along with the `list_id`,`folder_id`, and `space_id`. |
| `include_approval_history` | query | boolean |  | Include the history of the approval for each time entry. Adds status changes, notes, and approvers. |
| `include_approval_details` | query | boolean |  | Include the details of the approval for each time entry. Adds Approver ID, Approved Time, List of Approvers, and Approval Status. |
| `space_id` | query | number |  | Only include time entries associated with tasks in a specific Space. |
| `folder_id` | query | number |  | Only include time entries associated with tasks in a specific Folder. |
| `list_id` | query | number |  | Only include time entries associated with tasks in a specific List. |
| `task_id` | query | string |  | Only include time entries associated with a specific task. |
| `custom_task_ids` | query | boolean |  | If you want to reference a task by it's custom task id, this value must be `true`. |
| `team_id` | query | number |  | When the `custom_task_ids` parameter is set to `true`, the Workspace ID must be provided using the `team_id` parameter. For example: `custom_task_ids=true&team_id=123`. |
| `is_billable` | query | boolean |  | Include only billable time entries by using a value of `true` or only non-billable time entries by using a value of `false`. For example: `?is_billable=true`. |
